name: suite-tool-wrappers
body:
The opencode suite tool wrappers in opencode-suite/tools/*.ts, embedded into the binary by `src/main.rs` via `include_str!` and installed by `apg init`. `apg_plan_init.ts` becomes a plan-`add` tool; `apg_plan_add.ts` treats `kind` as optional (= the plan itself); new node/edge update/rm variants; new plan update/rm tools; `apg_plan_link.ts` retired.

The .ts files ARE scanned code in this graph, and their module identity is declared by `opencode-suite/package.json`'s npm `name` (`apg-opencode-suite`), so their FQNs (`apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.*`) are stable across every checkout and worktree, per `global.constraint.checkout-independent-module-identity`. The component therefore anchors `implemented-by` to the real suite code — the shared parse boundary `apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.csvToRows` that this change-set edits — not to the embedding Rust dispatcher.
